# Murto Hilali

> {{ site.description }}

Personal site and portfolio of Murto Hilali, a Biotech and Economics graduate of
the University of Waterloo. The writing is mostly computational biology and
machine learning applied to proteins — contact maps, binding-site prediction,
structure-based drug discovery — with occasional detours into tools, business,
and travel.

Write-ups are long-form and technical: each walks through a project's full
pipeline, including the dead ends, and links the repo and dataset where they
exist. News posts are short updates.
